blur-image.name: Blur image
blur-image.benefit: Pixelate, blur or black out part of a photo.

steps.name: Choose an image
steps.text: Choose one image with the box above, or drop it on it. JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP and TIFF files all work.

steps.name: Mark what to hide
steps.text: Drag across each part you want to hide. You can mark several areas, or tap Whole image. Pick Pixelate, Blur or Black box; for Pixelate and Blur, also pick a strength.

steps.name: Create and download
steps.text: Check the preview: it shows what will be saved. Tap Create image, then tap Download.

steps.name: Choose the GIF
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick a GIF. The page shows its size in pixels, how many frames it has, how long it runs and how big the file is.

steps.name: Pick the settings
steps.text: Choose Light, Medium or Heavy compression, a size, and whether to keep every frame or only 1 frame in 2 or 3.

steps.name: Compress and download
steps.text: Press Compress GIF and keep the tab open. The page shows the new GIF and its file size next to the original’s, then offers it to download.

compress-image.name: Compress images
compress-image.benefit: Make images smaller, by quality or a target size.

steps.name: Choose your images
steps.text: Choose up to 50 images with the box above, or drop them on it. JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP and TIFF files all work.

steps.name: Pick how much to compress
steps.text: Under “Compress by”, choose Quality and move the slider, or choose Target file size and type a size such as 500 KB. To make the pixel size smaller too, pick a value under “Longest side”.

steps.name: Download
steps.text: Each row shows the old and new size. Download each file, or take them all in one ZIP.

compress-video.name: Compress video
compress-video.benefit: Make a video smaller to send or share.

steps.name: Choose the video
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick a MOV or MP4 from your iPhone or camera. Once it reads the file, the page shows its size, resolution, frame rate and format.

steps.name: Pick the settings
steps.text: Balanced keeps the picture sharp. Smallest suits chat and email. Choose the 1080p option (long side up to 1920 pixels) or the 720p option (up to 1280 pixels) to shrink it further.

steps.name: Compress and download
steps.text: Press Compress and keep the tab open until it finishes. Then download the MP4.

compress-video-to-size.name: Compress video to a size
compress-video-to-size.benefit: Compress a video to a size you choose, such as 10 MB.

steps.name: Choose the video
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick an MP4 or MOV from your iPhone, camera or a screen recording. The page shows its resolution, frame rate, length and size.

steps.name: Pick the size
steps.text: Choose 10 MB, 25 MB or 50 MB, or choose Another size and type a number from 1 to 2000.

steps.name: Compress and download
steps.text: Press Compress and keep the tab open. When it’s done, the page shows the new size next to the limit you chose, a player to check the result, and a download link.

crop-image.name: Crop image
crop-image.benefit: Crop, rotate or flip a photo.

steps.name: Choose an image
steps.text: Choose one image with the box above, or drop it on it. JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP and TIFF files all work.

steps.name: Crop, rotate or flip
steps.text: Drag the crop box, or drag a corner to resize it. Pick a ratio such as 1:1 or 16:9, or type the width and height in pixels. Use Rotate left, Rotate right, Flip horizontal and Flip vertical to turn the picture.

steps.name: Create and download
steps.text: Tap Create image. A Download button appears, with the old and new size in pixels and in bytes.

edit-photo-metadata.name: Edit photo metadata
edit-photo-metadata.benefit: Change a photo’s date, time or location.

steps.name: Choose the photo
steps.text: Pick a JPG or HEIC photo. The page reads its location, date, time zone and camera fields and shows them as the original values.

steps.name: Change what you need
steps.text: Click the map, search for a place or type coordinates. Set a new date and time. The time zone is optional. Edit the camera, author or description if you want.

steps.name: Save the new photo
steps.text: Save the edited photo. The page reads the new file back and shows the location and date it now holds.

extract-frames-from-video.name: Extract frames
extract-frames-from-video.benefit: Save frames from a video as JPG pictures.

steps.name: Choose the video
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick an MP4 or MOV from your iPhone, camera or a screen recording. The page shows its size, resolution, frame rate, length and video format, and opens it in a player.

steps.name: Choose which frames
steps.text: Take one frame every few seconds over a stretch you set, or choose Moments I pick: pause the player where you want a picture and add that moment, or type a time. Then pick a size.

steps.name: Extract and download
steps.text: Press Extract frames and keep the tab open. Each picture appears with its time and a download link. With more than one, Download all saves them in one ZIP.

gif-to-mp4.name: GIF to MP4
gif-to-mp4.benefit: Turn an animated GIF into an MP4 video.

steps.name: Choose the GIF
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick an animated GIF. The page shows its size in pixels, how many frames it has, how long it runs and how big the file is.

steps.name: Pick the settings
steps.text: Choose a size, how many times in a row the animation plays (once, or 2, 3, 5 or 10 times) and whether transparent areas are filled with white or black.

steps.name: Convert and download
steps.text: Press Convert to MP4 and keep the tab open. The page shows the video, then offers it to download.

heic-to-jpg.name: HEIC to JPG
heic-to-jpg.benefit: Turn iPhone HEIC photos into JPG or PNG.

steps.name: Choose your HEIC photos
steps.text: Choose up to 50 HEIC photos with the box above, or drop them on it.

steps.name: Pick the settings
steps.text: Choose JPG or PNG. Leave “Remove location” on if you plan to share the photos. Turn on “Remove all camera and date info” to remove the camera and date info (EXIF). The color profile stays.

steps.name: Download
steps.text: Download each photo, or take them all in one ZIP.

image-converter.name: Image converter
image-converter.benefit: Change an image to JPG, PNG, WebP or another format.

steps.name: Choose your images
steps.text: Choose up to 50 images with the box above, or drop them on it. HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP and TIFF files all work.

steps.name: Pick the output format and settings
steps.text: Choose the format under “Convert to”. For JPG, WebP and AVIF, set the quality. For JPG and BMP, choose the background color for transparent areas. Leave “Remove location” on if you plan to share the images.

steps.name: Download
steps.text: Download each converted image, or take them all in one ZIP.

mov-to-mp4.name: MOV to MP4
mov-to-mp4.benefit: Turn a MOV video into an MP4.

steps.name: Choose the MOV
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick a MOV from your iPhone, camera or a screen recording. The page shows its size, resolution, frame rate and video format.

steps.name: Check the video setting
steps.text: An H.264 video is copied as it is. For an HEVC video, keep “Re-encode to H.264” to play it almost anywhere (on iPhone and iPad, the page won’t start it if the new file is estimated to be over 300 MB), or choose “Copy the video as it is” for a fast copy.

steps.name: Convert and download
steps.text: Press Convert to MP4 and keep the tab open. The page checks the new file, then offers the MP4 to download.

photo-border.name: Photo border
photo-border.benefit: Add a border, or make a photo square without cropping.

steps.name: Choose a photo
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.

steps.name: Pick a style
steps.text: Choose an even border, a Polaroid card with room for a caption, or padding that makes the photo 1:1 or 4:5 without cropping it.

steps.name: Set the width and color, then download
steps.text: Slide the width, pick a color, and save the result as JPG or PNG.

photo-collage.name: Photo collage
photo-collage.benefit: Put several photos into one image or one long strip.

steps.name: Add your photos
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick your photos or screenshots. HEIC photos work too.

steps.name: Choose a layout
steps.text: Pick Collage for a grid in a 1:1, 4:5, 3:4 or 9:16 shape, or Long strip to stack photos from top to bottom. Use the arrows to change the order.

steps.name: Download
steps.text: Check the preview, then download the result as JPG or PNG.

remove-photo-location.name: Remove photo location
remove-photo-location.benefit: Take the GPS location out of a photo before you share it.

steps.name: Choose your photos
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick JPG or HEIC photos, or drop them on it. The page first lists what each photo contains.

steps.name: Choose what to remove
steps.text: “Remove location” is on by default. Turn on “Remove everything” to also drop camera, lens and date info.

steps.name: Check and download
steps.text: Each new file is read again to confirm the location is gone. Then download it, or take everything in one ZIP.

remove-video-metadata.name: Remove video metadata
remove-video-metadata.benefit: Take the location, device and date out of a video.

steps.name: Choose the video
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick an MP4, MOV or M4V from your iPhone, Android phone, camera or a screen recording. The page lists what it found in the video.

steps.name: Remove the metadata
steps.text: Press Remove metadata. The page makes a new file and reads it again to check it. If part of the file can’t be checked, it says so.

steps.name: Download
steps.text: Download the new file. Its name ends in -no-metadata, and your original file stays as it was.

resize-image.name: Resize images
resize-image.benefit: Change the width and height in pixels or percent.

steps.name: Choose your images
steps.text: Choose up to 50 images with the box above, or drop them on it. JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP and TIFF files all work.

steps.name: Set the new size
steps.text: Type a width, a height or both in pixels, or set “Resize by” to Percentage and type a number such as 50. Leave “Keep the aspect ratio” on so the image is not stretched.

steps.name: Download
steps.text: Each row shows the old and new pixel size. Download each file, or take them all in one ZIP.

video-to-gif.name: Video to GIF
video-to-gif.benefit: Turn part of a video into an animated GIF.

steps.name: Choose the video
steps.text: Tap the box above and pick an MP4 or MOV from your iPhone, camera or a screen recording. The page shows its size, resolution, frame rate, length and video format.

steps.name: Pick the clip and settings
steps.text: Type the second where the GIF should start and choose a length: 2, 3, 5, 8, 10, 15 or 20 seconds. Then pick a frame rate, a width and whether the GIF loops.

steps.name: Make and download
steps.text: Press Make GIF and keep the tab open. The page shows a preview of the GIF, then offers it to download.
